title: cerastium ligusticum subsp. palustre
intro: Cerastium ligusticum subsp. palustre, commonly known as marsh chickweed, is a plant species belonging to the Caryophyllaceae family. This perennial herb has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, which include treating skin conditions, wounds, and digestive issues due to its anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of marsh chickweed are attributed to its ability to soothe and calm irritated tissues, reduce inflammation, and promote wound healing. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, glycosides, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
